purpose: DESNZ Quarterly Energy Prices average domestic prices paid: standard electricity (table 2.2.4) and gas (table 2.3.4) average variable unit costs (GBP per kWh) and fixed costs (GBP per year) by QEP price region and payment method (standard credit, direct debit, prepayment, all), including VAT, calendar and fiscal years 2023 to 2025. Consumed by the LCFS energy pricing step in place of the Ofgem cap levels (the cap stays vendored as the regional maximum).
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
